key_insight: Kriging and neural-network models can predict pressure losses across perforated plates more accurately than standard empirical formulas in turbulent flow.
engineering_relevance: The proposed data-driven pressure-loss models can be embedded into RANS simulations to improve CFD predictions for perforated-plate devices.
method: Trained kriging and neural network regressors on two experimental datasets from the literature.
Compared predictions against commonly used empirical pressure-loss correlations.
Implemented the new models as momentum source terms in 2D channel-flow RANS simulations.
evidence_signal: Across the available experimental configurations, both models generally matched measurements well and outperformed existing empirical formulas in most cases.
watch_item: The models were developed from relatively limited experimental data, so reliability may depend on how well new cases match the training configurations.
paper_title: Kriging and neural network models for pressure losses across perforated plates
